title: CONSTRUCTION, MAINTENANCE, AND ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS
previewText: Where an easement volume is provided pursuant to Section 66-20 (SPECIAL PROVISIONS FOR PRIMARY TRANSIT-ADJACENT SITES) or Section 66-30 (SPECIAL PROVISIONS FORSECONDARY TRANSIT-ADJACENT SITES) the provisions of this Section, inclusive, shall apply. Where a clear path is provided pursuant to the aforementioned Sections, the provisions of Section 66-42 (Termination of a Transit Volume) shall also apply.
